scheme_name: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II
description:
The Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II is an initiative launched by the Government of India in 2021. 

This scheme is a continuation of the original Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science which was initiated in 2014. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to identify and nurture young talents in the field of science and technology. 

The scheme aims to encourage students from classes 6 to 12 to take an interest in scientific research and innovation. 

The specific goal is to enhance the scientific temper among the youth and promote research-oriented education. 

The scheme is designed to provide financial assistance and mentorship to selected students. 

The total budget allocated for the Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II is approximately ₹100 crores. 

Under this scheme, students can receive a scholarship of ₹5,000 per month for a duration of two years. 

The scheme targets a total of 1,000 students each year. 

To be eligible for this scheme, students must be enrolled in recognized schools across India. 

Students must be in classes 6 to 12 to qualify for the benefits of this scheme. 

There is no specific income criterion for eligibility. 

However, preference is given to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. 

The application process for the scheme involves several steps. 

First, students must fill out an online application form available on the official website. 

The application form requires personal details including name, age, and educational background. 

Students must also provide details about their achievements in science-related activities. 

After submitting the application, students must upload necessary documents such as school identity proof and certificates of achievements. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set for the end of July each year. 

Once the applications are received, a selection committee reviews them based on predefined criteria. 

The selection process includes an evaluation of the students' scientific aptitude and achievements. 

Shortlisted candidates are then called for an interview or a written test. 

The final list of selected students is published on the official website by the end of August. 

Selected students receive their scholarship amount directly into their bank accounts. 

The disbursement of the scholarship occurs on a quarterly basis. 

Each selected student receives ₹15,000 every three months. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme also includes mentorship programs. 

Mentorship is provided by experienced scientists and researchers from various fields. 

Students are encouraged to participate in science fairs and competitions at national and international levels. 

The scheme also facilitates workshops and seminars to enhance students' practical knowledge. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Science and Technology under the Ministry of Science and Technology. 

The Department of Science and Technology is responsible for overseeing the implementation and monitoring of the scheme. 

For any queries related to the scheme, students and parents can contact the Department of Science and Technology. 

The contact details for the department are available on the official government website. 

The scheme aims to create a pool of talented young scientists who can contribute to India's scientific advancements. 

It is expected that by 2025, the scheme will have supported over 5,000 students. 

The initiative also aligns with the National Policy on Education which emphasizes the importance of STEM education. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort to promote research and innovation in India. 

It aims to bridge the gap between school education and higher education in science. 

The scheme also encourages collaboration between schools and research institutions. 

Students are motivated to pursue careers in science and technology through various incentives. 

The scheme is particularly beneficial for students from rural and semi-urban areas. 

It aims to reduce the disparity in access to quality science education across different regions. 

The initiative has received positive feedback from educational institutions and parents alike. 

Many students have reported increased interest in science subjects due to the support provided by the scheme. 

The scheme also encourages students to think critically and solve real-world problems. 

It fosters a culture of innovation and creativity among young minds. 

The government plans to expand the scope of the scheme in the coming years. 

Future expansions may include additional funding and resources for selected students. 

The scheme is a vital step towards building a strong foundation for scientific research in India. 

It aims to empower the next generation of scientists and innovators. 

Overall, the Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II is a comprehensive initiative. 

It provides financial support and mentorship to young students interested in science. 

The scheme is designed to create a conducive environment for scientific exploration and innovation. 

It plays a crucial role in shaping the future of science and technology in India. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the quality of science education through such initiatives. 

The success of the scheme will be measured by the number of students pursuing careers in science and technology. 

In conclusion, the Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II is a significant welfare initiative. 

It aims to inspire and nurture young talents in the field of science. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on India's scientific landscape. 

The government encourages all eligible students to apply and take advantage of this opportunity. 

This initiative is a testament to India's commitment to fostering scientific excellence.
